note: Rubric axes for a completed run. Each is a hard pass/fail against artifacts on disk.

axes.assert: every row with a non-empty primary_line_type has a non-empty line_type_source drawn from the allowlist
axes.why: US number portability makes any computed line type structurally meaningless; a type without a source is not trustworthy

axes.assert: every input APN appears in COVERAGE.json with a disposition from the closed vocabulary
axes.why: a row with no disposition is a silent blank, and 'we never looked' must stay distinct from 'we looked and rejected it'

axes.assert: no number lacking a DNC value lacks the literal 'NOT YET SCRUBBED — do not dial or text'
axes.why: dial-readiness is a PER-ROW property; an unstamped unscrubbed number reads as dialable

axes.assert: no suppressed owner appears on the Call List sheet, and every suppression carries its literal matched pattern on the audit sheet
axes.why: pinellas.json said 'screen out explicitly' in a COMMENT ONLY and Stauffer shipped. A comment in a config is not a filter
raw harvested text once leaked 72 cleartext passwords into the iCloud root; the scan is scoped so approved phone columns pass and everywhere else blocks

axes.assert: the run manifest records the frozen snapshot hash and cordata_vintage
axes.why: a deliverable must be tied to the exact code and registry snapshot that produced it; a vintage older than 45 days warns and offers the delta pull

axes.assert: ownership_status, role_status and phone_attribution_status are populated independently and no row renders PRIMARY MOBILE without VERIFIED-PHONE AND VERIFIED-MOBILE
axes.why: collapsing the three is the confident-error this skill exists to prevent

axes.assert: no truth-valued field serializes as N where the check never ran
axes.why: doctrine 18 — a deceased check that never ran must not render as 'not deceased'

axes.assert: HUMANS.json carries unresolved_frontier whenever an entity chain did not terminate in a natural person
axes.why: three hops is an operational limit, not a confidence statement; omitting the frontier implies the chain ended
axes.check: schemas/humans.schema.json requires it at the document level

axes.assert: coverage is reported as classified mobiles / non-suppressed owner rows against the 0.50 bar
axes.why: the KPI denominator is stated once and computed one way, so runs are comparable
